auth.label: Prowlarr address (usually port 9696)
auth.help: Where your own Prowlarr runs, as host or host:port, such as 192.168.1.10:9696, with 1337x added as an indexer. 1337x answers with a Cloudflare challenge, so add FlareSolverr in Prowlarr under Settings > Indexers > Indexer Proxies and give it the same tag as the 1337x indexer.

auth.label: Prowlarr indexer id of 1337x
auth.help: A number. In Prowlarr open Indexers and click 1337x: the number in its Torznab URL, such as the 3 in http://192.168.1.10:9696/3/, is the id.

auth.label: Prowlarr API key
auth.help: In Prowlarr, Settings > General > Security > API Key.
